description: Prompt mặc trang phục thời kỳ Neanderthal 51ka lên body nora_body_v3_clean.jpg, giữ nguyên 100% giải phẫu cơ thể từ nora_base_body_prompt.json (ngực đầy nhô cao, eo con kiến, chân dài thon, 3 panel cắt ngang vai).
image_prompt: BODY REFERENCE ONLY, NO FACE. Use the woman in the source image only for her skin tone, hair colour and general build; no part of her face appears. BODY: tall slender woman about 178 cm with a pronounced hourglass figure. Long slim legs, longer than half her height, with slender toned thighs, slim calves and a clear gap between the thighs; the legs are lean, not heavy. A very small, narrow, sharply defined waist that is much narrower than both her bust and her hips, with a flat toned stomach. A large, full, heavy natural bust that clearly fills out the top and projects well forward in the side view. Hips rounded, in proportion with the bust. Slim arms and shoulders. Fit, healthy, athletic-slim build. Skin: fair, clear and bright. 16:9 model reference sheet in the style of modeling-agency digitals, exactly three panels side by side on a plain light-grey studio background, the same woman in every panel, soft even daylight, 50mm lens with no distortion, sharp focus, high detail. FRAMING: in every panel the top edge of the frame cuts horizontally across her shoulders at the base of the neck; her head, chin, mouth and face are completely outside the frame and never visible; only the ends of her honey-blonde ponytail may show over one shoulder. LEFT panel: body from the shoulders to the feet facing the camera, arms relaxed slightly away from the body so the waist curve is visible. MIDDLE panel: body from the shoulders to the feet in a three-quarter turn, showing the side profile of bust, small waist and hips. RIGHT panel: body from the shoulders to the feet seen from behind. Clothing: a skin-tight, form-fitting tailored tunic of smoked golden-tan deer suede that hugs the body closely like a second skin, following every curve, accentuating the large full heavy bust with a laced plunging V-neckline tied with thin leather thongs, tightly pulled in at the very small narrow waist with a wide dark-brown leather belt that sharply defines her hourglass curves; a hood edged with thick grey wolf fur resting back on her shoulders; long fitted sleeves with grey wolf-fur cuffs; skin-tight golden-tan hide leggings closely hugging her slender long legs and toned thighs; knee-high fitted suede boots wrapped with leather thongs. Natural neutral standing poses, non-sexual. BODY LOCK (CRITICAL): The body must match the source image exactly -- voluptuous hourglass figure, large full bust, tiny narrow waist, wide curvaceous hips, long slender legs. NOT loose, NOT baggy, NOT a boxy parka, NOT a caveman fur pelt, NOT reducing the bust, NOT hiding the waist. Photorealistic RAW photograph, real natural leather and skin texture. No text, labels, captions or logos.
